artifacts.summary: Nine phases, ~13h, waves [[1,2],[3],[4],[5],[6],[7],[8],[9]]; lake build green at every phase boundary.

notes: PLANNER DEVIATION (stated in the plan Overview, not silent): the IsValid -> ValidIn restatement is split across two phases rather than one. Phase 5 restates the benign .Base half (axiom_swap_valid_general plus the eight transplanted survivors at ValidIn FrameClass.Base) BEFORE arm extraction, so the ~29 lemmas Phases 6-7 create are born in final form. Phase 8 remains the final, isolated, highest-risk phase and carries the entire SuccOrder/PredOrder defeq hazard, the Decidable.lean:2413 retarget, and the only C2 exposure. Rationale: extracting at IsValid first would force Phase 8 to additionally restate ~29 signatures, making the riskiest phase a ~35-declaration edit and defeating the isolation the instruction exists to provide. Fallback to the literal single-phase ordering is documented in Rollback/Contingency. Widened file_scope (Decidability/Verified/Decidable.lean) is planned in Phase 8. All five research-only dead declarations are covered; the two that become dead only when axiom_swap_valid goes are deleted in Phase 3, in the same edit as their sole consumer. D-09 is encoded narrowly (exactly four constructor arms). and_of_not_imp_not cross-directory consolidation is an explicit non-goal.
summary: Nine-phase implementation plan created for the SoundnessLemmas consolidation. Phases 1-2 (parallel) delete the already-dead ranges and deduplicate exists_isGLB_of_lub; 3 retires axiom_swap_valid and the two lemmas that die with it; 4 transplants the eight survivors and deletes DenseValidity.lean; 5 restates the .Base layer at ValidIn FrameClass.Base; 6-7 one-line the 45-arm dispatcher; 8 is the isolated final code phase retiring IsValid and Core.lean including the widened Decidable.lean scope; 9 regenerates docs and runs the acceptance gate. lake build green at every phase boundary.
